messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty triggered: p99 latency breach for eu-dedicated pool (alert-id: A-89321) — p99 > 3.2s over last 1m. Link: https://metrics.example/reports/A-89321
sara_oncall: acked. I'm on it. seeing p95 ~ 700ms, p99 ~ 3.2s. streaming stalls noted from support. paging SRE.
emma_support: reporting: AcmeCorp and Velox saw stalls in streaming sessions (clients dropped) starting ~ 08:01 UTC. Support ticket #45322 opened.
mike_sre: looking at pool telemetry — queue_depth(eu-dedicated-hotshot) spiked to 18k, warmup_failures increasing. Autoscaler logs show repeated "warmup handshake timeout" and backoff. metrics: https://metrics.example/dashboards/eu-dedicated
lee_runtime: confirmed: autoscaler attempted to add 6 slots in last 3m; kube jobs started but warmup hook (handshake) timed out 80% of attempts. snippet from runtime logs: ```[08:03:12] warmup: handshake timeout client=hotshot-init id=0x7f3 err=ETIMEDOUT```
sara_oncall: runbook check: dedicated-warmup-runbook. Step1: verify scaling. Step2: consider manual scale or fallback routing. I'll try manual scale to relieve queue.
mike_sre: running manual scale now: ```/runbook scale-pool --pool eu-dedicated-hotshot --add 4 --reason "manual relief"``` returning job id job-8842.
ops_bot: Job created: job-8842 provisioning 4 hotshot slots (image: rwd-hotshot:2026-03-12). Estimated ready: 2m.
lee_runtime: KV cache cold-miss rate also rising — new slots will have empty KV cache which hurts streaming; we should also consider prefix cache warmup but that was the handshake that failed.
emma_support: customer-visible counts: AcmeCorp: 14 sessions dropped, 62 stalls retried; Velox: 9 stalls. Notified SOC.
mike_sre: while nodes come up, propose partial traffic shift to eu-dedicated-fallback pool (less bursty config) and lower-quality model to preserve latency. Approve?
product_oncall: approve shifting up to 40% traffic to fallback. Need to call out possible quality degradation to product.
mike_sre: executing traffic reroute: ```/route shift --from eu-dedicated-hotshot --to eu-dedicated-fallback --percent 30 --sticky true```
ops_bot: Route change applied — 30% of new traffic now hitting eu-dedicated-fallback.
jon_prod: monitoring p95/p99: currently p95 -> 610ms, p99 -> 2.4s (was 3.2s). Streaming stalls metric still shows tail events at ~08:06.
lee_runtime: logs show persistent "handshake refused" from warmup agent on a subset of nodes (same image). digging into image pull and startup hooks. Could be an init script regression.
sara_oncall: any ETA on the 4 manual slots?
ops_bot: job-8842 reports 3/4 slots ready at 08:07:40, last one in warmup. Warmup success rate improving for new slots.
mike_sre: p99 trending down to 1.8s after the 30% reroute + 3 new slots. but streaming stall count still nonzero — looks like a small group of requests still hitting cold nodes.
lee_runtime: suggestion: restart streaming-router pods slowly to force reconnects onto warmed nodes. this will drop some in-flight streams briefly but reduce long-tail stalls. we should do a rolling restart with maxUnavailable=1.
sara_oncall: agree. authorize rolling restart for eu streaming-router. Doing now.
ops_bot: RollingRestart started: streaming-router-eu deployment (strategy: rolling, maxUnavailable=1).
ops_bot: RollingRestart: pod-11 restarted at 08:09:12, pod-12 restarted at 08:10:05.
jon_prod: after restart p95 -> 580ms, p99 -> 1.4s. streaming stalls reduced ~70%. still seeing sporadic handshake timeouts (1-2/min).
lee_runtime: root cause hypothesis: autoscaler warmup hook expects a handshake to our init agent that sometimes stalls on certain kernel/cloud runtimes — when handshake fails autoscaler backs off and capacity lags, producing queue amplification. the warmup gating prevents the slot from serving until handshake completes, causing longer queues.
mike_sre: mitigation proposal: temporarily disable warmup gating for autoscaler so nodes become available and accept traffic while warmup proceeds async. We'll only do this for eu-dedicated-hotshot until we patch the warmup hook. Risks: some requests hit nodes lacking warmed KV cache (slightly higher latency), but overall latency improves vs queueing.
sara_oncall: +1. apply temporary config change and watch.
lee_runtime: applying config change: ```kubectl apply -f autoscaler-tmp-disable-warmup.yaml --namespace=redwood-inference``` — turning off gating for pool eu-dedicated-hotshot.
ops_bot: autoscaler config updated. New slots will join without gating.
jon_prod: p99 dropped to 900ms within 90s. queue_depth dropping fast. streaming stalls nearly resolved; current stall rate down to background noise.
emma_support: updating customers: AcmeCorp notified of mitigation and asked to validate. They replied their stream reconnects succeeded and error rate is back down.
product_oncall: FYI — this will affect model quality for very short prefix warmups; prod accepts for now.
sara_oncall: incident declared SEV2 due to customer impact and SLO breach. Creating incident doc and assigning postmortem.
incident-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0315-072. Severity=SEV2. Link: https://incidents.example/INC-2026-0315-072
mike_sre: notes added to incident: autoscaler backoff + warmup handshake timeouts cause capacity lag -> queue amplification -> p99 spikes. Immediate mitigations: manual scale, partial reroute, rolling restart, disable warmup-gating. Long-term: patch warmup hook and add canaries for image/init.
lee_runtime: opened PR to change handshake timeout and improve retries: https://git.example/r/redwood/runtime/pulls/678 (owner: lee_runtime). Also filing infra task to run warmup smoke tests in pre-prod images.
sara_oncall: assign postmortem to lee_runtime and mike_sre. ETA for fix: patch merged + canary + deploy within 24h. I'll hand this off to night oncall. @ryan_night — please watch the fallback routing and autoscaler behavior through the night and escalate if p99 > 1.5s for >5m.
ryan_night: acknowledged. I'll pick it up and post updates on the incident channel if anything regresses.
sara_oncall: summary for handoff: primary cause autoscaler warmup handshake failures -> capacity added too slowly. mitigations applied: manual scale, 30% reroute to fallback, rolling restart, temporary disable warmup gating. customers notified. Postmortem owners assigned. Closing live mitigation.
emma_support: I'll follow up with customer comms and include timeline.
sara_oncall: handing off incident thread to @ryan_night — leaving notes in incident doc. Good job team.
product_oncall: thanks all.
